Title: Show HN: Olumino, a Markdown notes and spaced repetition app
Description:
I was inspired by Mochi and Anki, but wanted to make something that’s a mix of the two. Anki is very confusing and has an outdated interface while Mochi is very simple and has a more minimalist interface. Olumino is the combination of both.

I also added Japanese flashcard support, including kana readings, for anyone learning the language.

I’m a CS student building this in my free time, so I’d love to hear what people think!

Description:
a ball will fall. trade on where it lands.

I made this game! Some technical details:

The entire drop of the ball is simulated server-side, then streamed to each client as server-sent events with a small buffer. Every drop is deterministic from its starting position, so rounds can be replayed exactly for later analysis, but tiny variations in starting position can change the ultimate outcome.
